title: nephelium noronhianum
intro: Nephelium noronhianum, commonly known as the Rumbia or Indian rambutan, is a species of fruit-bearing tree native to the Western Ghats in India. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Nephelium noronhianum include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-diarrheal effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds and flavonoids. However, specific research on the bioactive constituents of Nephelium noronhianum is limited, and further studies are required to fully elucidate its properties.
